h1: Blue Mountain "Spooky Blues" 48 N. Spooky Lane
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Gulf views- Low-Speed Vehicle Available from March 1st - November 1st- Short walk to beach access- Private pool **Pool heating available Oct 1-May 1 for $30 per day**- Convenient location- Elevator- Outdoor Grill- Private saltwater pool- Stand Alone Ice Maker- 6 adult bikes provided- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Spooky Blues is a majestic 5-bedroom, 5.5-bathroom, Gulf-view home that sleeps 16, nestled in the serene Blue Mountain Beach community. Located along the glittering Emerald Coast, this spacious 3,200-square-foot sanctuary boasts 2 spacious balconies, a private saltwater pool, a propane grill, and dedicated beach access only 250 yards away!The ground floor of this 3-story residence greets guests with warm hardwood floors and a sun-filled living area, complete with an adjoining wet bar and 3-stool bar top. A bunk room with 2 queen-over-queen beds and a private bathroom provides a cozy sanctuary for kids or those young at heart. French doors lead to a covered patio dressed in comfortable outdoor furniture and an entertainment-ready TV set against a private saltwater pool backdrop. Dip in the shimmering water before relishing the sun on loungers or gently swaying in the breeze on 2 hammocks.Use the in-home elevator or decorative staircase to ascend the second floor—the heart of this home. Culinary enthusiasts will delight in the kitchen, a testament to form and function with its granite countertops, custom cabinets, and high-end appliances. Morning banter and evening cocktails can be enjoyed around the spacious kitchen island that doubles as a 6-stool breakfast bar. The living area, an inviting ensemble of plush furniture and gorgeous picture windows, showcases exquisite views. The primary bedroom offers a serene escape, featuring a king bed and a private bathroom with a spa tub. Venture outside from the great room to find a second-floor deck where a picnic table and sitting area await, shaded for comfort and perfect for alfresco dining.The top floor boasts a thoughtfully designed primary bedroom with a king bed, a private bathroom, a sleeper sofa, and a wet bar. Step outside to the private balcony, lounge on the day bed, or sink into additional seating as the skyline stretches beyond. Two more bedrooms, each with a king bed and private bath, ensure unparalleled privacy. A laundry room can also be found on this floor for convenience.Spooky Blues is an ideal getaway for families and friends eager to create lasting memories. With on-site parking for 4-5 vehicles and 6 complimentary adult bikes, it’s easy to explore the area. The nearest beach access is a 3-minute walk to Spooky Lane Public Beach, which can be found across the boardwalk on Spooky Lane. Book now!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 16):FIRST FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: 2 Queen-over-Queen Bunk Beds, Private Bathroom with Shower onlySECOND FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Jacuzzi Tub SeparateTHIRD FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: King Bed and Queen Sleeper Sofa, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyNearby Attractions:30A Artists at Gulf Place Town CenterEd Walline Beach Access, ADA Accessible30A Timpoochee Multi-Use TrailBiking Distance to Grayton Beach State ParkShunk Gulley at Gulf PlaceWeddings are not allowed at this home. You may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments if this policy is violated. You may also be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.*Unfortunately no pets allowed in this home at any time.**Please note that in order to utilize the golf cart that comes with the home, you will be required to pay a $30 non-refundable deposit to 30a Gulf Carts.
